description: Delete a given list of objects from the user's graph, up to 200 object_ids in one call. Use only when the user explicitly asked for these particular objects to go, never to tidy up on your own initiative. The delete is soft and reversible: the objects drop out of lists, search and chat, and restore_graph_objects with the returned deleted_ids brings them back. One object is delete_graph_object; every object of a type is delete_graph_objects. Only objects the user owns are deleted, never their root user node; the rest come back as skipped. Not available in the YouSpot chat, where the user ticks the rows in their lists instead.
name: delete_selected_graph_objects
title: Delete several brain objects
